text: 10月9日，中国人民银行行长潘功胜会见法国总统外事顾问博纳。双方就当前经济金融形势、中法经济金融合作等议题交换了意见。
text_en: On October 9, PBOC Governor Pan Gongsheng met with Bonne, Foreign Affairs Advisor to the French President. The two sides exchanged views on the current economic and financial situation, China-France economic and financial cooperation, and other topics.
